# CANDIDATE: V14E_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21

## Hypothesis

We aim to capture more of the big directional moves on winner days by using a trailing profit lock that arms at 5% profit and trails at 10% of the high water mark, allowing runners to extend while protecting gains. Combined with a delayed entry start (09:35 ET) to avoid morning chop and a conservative TP1 at 30% (selling half), we seek to improve edge capture on J's winner days while minimizing losses on loser days through tighter initial stops and profit-lock discipline.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** No trades before 09:35 ET; requires ≥1 bearish trigger (min_triggers_bear=1); ATM put strike (strike_offset_bear=0).  
**Exit:**  
- TP1 at +30% premium, sell 50% of position (tp1_qty_fraction=0.5)  
- Profit lock arms at +5% profit, then trails stop at 10% below high water mark (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.1)  
- Runner target at +250% premium (runner_target_premium_pct=2.5)  
- Catastrophe premium stop at -20% (premium_stop_pct_bear=-0.2)
